Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the seizure or confiscation of firearms during a state of emergency or natural disaster.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the seizure or confiscation of firearms duringa state of emergency or natural disaster; adding a new section tochapter 38.52 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 38.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Pursuant to the second amendment to the United StatesConstitution and Article I, section 24 of the Washington stateConstitution, nothing under this or any other provision of law shall beconstrued to authorize: (a) The seizure or confiscation of a firearm or ammunition duringan emergency or disaster, except: (i) From a person who is unlawfullycarrying or in unlawful possession of a firearm or ammunition, (ii)when seized or confiscated as evidence in a criminal investigation, or(iii) when forfeited in compliance with RCW 9.41.098; or (b) The governor, any political subdivision, or any othergovernmental authority to impose additional restrictions on the lawfulpossession, transfer, sale, transport, carrying, storage, display, oruse of a firearm or ammunition during an emergency or disaster. p. 1 SB 5516 (2) In addition to any remedy provided by law or in equity, anindividual aggrieved by the seizure or confiscation of a firearm inviolation of this section may bring an action for the return of thefirearm in the jurisdiction in which the individual resides or in whichthe firearm may be found. The court may award reasonable attorneys'fees to the prevailing party. (3) As used in this section, "firearm" has the meaning ascribed toit in RCW 9.41.010.
This act may be known and cited as theemergency management firearm owners' protection act.
